critter_emberkit.replaces: critter fallback (two balls, ears and the rarity colour)
critter_emberkit.notes: One mesh, stands on the origin facing -Y; scale to the manifest height. The mascot and the reference critter for the HD standard. The lantern is baked bright, no Neon: code adds a small amber PointLight (range 8, brightness 1.5) at the lantern, on the viewer's right about 0.55 of the height up.

train_engine.replaces: engine fallback (red block body, black cylinder boiler, chimney)
train_engine.notes: Engine and tender, 22 x 11 x 8 (architecture section 9). Wheels on y = 0 (rail top), front -Z, cab floor 2.3 up. Three meshes: train_engine (textured), train_engine_lamp_glow (Neon: headlamp lens and side panes, tender tail lamp) and train_engine_fire_glow (Neon: firebox door and grate, cab spectacles). Chimney top centre (smoke): 5.5 forward of the middle, 11 up. Cab roof (the engine's turret): a gentle arch 8.2 to 8.65 up, 7.9 wide, from 2.1 behind the middle to 6.5 behind. Code adds a SpotLight on the lamp (range 60, angle 50, brightness 3) and an orange PointLight in the cab (range 12). Static: the wheels do not turn.

house_cottage.replaces: none (style-test house of the stop_village set; not uploaded on its own)
house_cottage.notes: Ground at y = 0, platform top at 2, platform edge facing -Z towards the track. Two meshes: house_cottage (textured) and house_cottage_glow (Neon: windows, door porthole, dormer, the sign lamp and the lamp post). Code adds a PointLight per lit window (range 12, brightness 1.2) and on the lamp post (range 18). Mesh CanCollide false; collide with invisible parts: the platform box and a cylinder for the house.
